# Accept epoch-zero work through the actual disabled production daemon first.
server start
taskfile task.json success
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id legacy-known --wait
job-id LEGACY
[linux-retry] taskfile retry.json failonce
[linux-retry] skygo --json run -f retry.json --request-id legacy-retry --wait
server stop
skygo --json state retention enable --data-dir $DATA --request-window 1h
retention-domain OLD
server start
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id legacy-known
stdout '"id": *"'$LEGACY'"'
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $OLD --request-id before-restore --wait
job-id JOB
server stop
cp $DATA/jobs.db source-before.db
skygo state backup --data-dir $DATA --output backup.db
cmp $DATA/jobs.db source-before.db
skygo state compact --data-dir $DATA --output compact.db
cmp $DATA/jobs.db source-before.db
! skygo state compact --data-dir $DATA --output compact.db
cmp $DATA/jobs.db source-before.db
skygo --json state restore --data-dir restored --input compact.db
retention-domain NEW
stdout '"legacy_replay_open":false'
copy-outputs restored
server-directory restored
server start
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
stdout '"id": *"'$JOB'"'
skygo --json jobs get $LEGACY
stdout '"id": *"'$LEGACY'"'
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $OLD --request-id before-restore
stderr 'request lineage changed'
! skygo run -f task.json --request-id legacy-known
stderr 'request epoch expired'
! skygo run -f task.json --request-id absent-legacy
stderr 'request epoch expired'
[linux-retry] ! skygo run -f retry.json --request-id legacy-retry
[linux-retry] stderr 'request epoch expired'
[linux-retry] ! skygo run -f retry.json --request-id absent-legacy-retry
[linux-retry] stderr 'request epoch expired'
[linux-retry] event-count 4
[!linux-retry] event-count 2
server stop
! stderr .
